title: GPUs (nvidia-exporter)
description: NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs from nvidia-exporter 0.5.0+ (https://github.com/johnciavarella/nvidia-exporter): the common gpu_* metrics plus vendor-specific panels.

list.name: hostlabel
list.label: Host label
list.description: The label that names a host: `instance` for a plain Prometheus scrape, or the label your pipeline adds (for example `host_name` from OpenTelemetry).

panels.title: Exporters with errors
panels.description: Exporters whose last collection failed (gpu_exporter_collection_error = 1). 0 = all healthy.

targets.expr: sum(max by (host, vendor) (label_replace(gpu_exporter_collection_error{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPU power now
panels.description: Total current power draw of the selected GPUs.

targets.expr: sum(max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_power_draw_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Busiest GPU
panels.description: Highest current utilization among the selected GPUs.

targets.expr: max(max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_utilization_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Hottest sensor
panels.description: Highest current temperature of any sensor on the selected GPUs.

targets.expr: max(max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_temperature_celsius{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)")))

panels.title: GPUs
panels.description: One row per GPU. Bars are a share of 0-100%. An empty cell means that GPU does not report the value.

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_utilization_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_memory_used_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)")) / max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_memory_total_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_memory_total_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_power_draw_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_power_limit_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_temperature_celsius{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, vendor) (label_replace(gpu_exporter_collection_error{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: GPU utilization
panels.description: NVIDIA: utilization.gpu. AMD: gpu_busy_percent. Intel: estimated from RC6 residency, bounded by the engine busy times.

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_utilization_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: VRAM used (% of total)
panels.description: VRAM in use as a share of the card's total. Inference servers such as vLLM reserve most VRAM at start-up.

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_memory_used_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)")) / max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_memory_total_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: VRAM used
panels.description: VRAM in use (solid) and the card's total (dashed). Intel needs --intel-xpu-smi-path.

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_memory_used_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_memory_total_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Memory controller utilization
panels.description: Share of time the memory controller was busy (NVIDIA utilization.memory, AMD mem_busy_percent).

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_memory_utilization_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Power draw
panels.description: Power draw (solid) and the power limit (dashed).

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_power_draw_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_power_limit_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Power as % of limit
panels.description: Power draw divided by the power limit. Sustained values near 100% mean the GPU is power-limited.

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_power_draw_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)")) / max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_power_limit_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Energy over the time range
panels.description: Energy used over the dashboard's time range, from gpu_energy_joules_total (reported by Intel hwmon).

targets.expr: sum by (host) (label_replace(increase(gpu_energy_joules_total{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}[$__range]), "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)")) / 3.6e6

panels.title: Hottest sensor per GPU
panels.description: The hottest temperature sensor on each GPU. Per-sensor detail is below.

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_temperature_celsius{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Temperatures — $host
panels.description: Every temperature sensor on this host's GPU: edge/gpu = die, junction = hottest point, mem/vram = memory.

targets.expr: max by (sensor) (gpu_temperature_celsius{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"$host"})

panels.title: Fan speed (%)
panels.description: Fan duty as a share of maximum (NVIDIA fan.speed, AMD pwm1 / pwm1_max).

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_fan_speed_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Fan speed (RPM)
panels.description: Fan speed from hwmon fan1_input (AMD, Intel where present).

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_fan_speed_rpm{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Graphics clock
panels.description: Current graphics clock. Intel: intel_gpu_top's actual frequency.

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_clock_graphics_hz{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Memory clock
panels.description: Current memory clock (NVIDIA, AMD).

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_clock_memory_hz{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Core voltage
panels.description: GPU core voltage from hwmon in0_input (AMD vddgfx, Intel).

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor, gpu, name) (label_replace(gpu_voltage_volts{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Collection status
panels.description: gpu_exporter_collection_error per exporter. ERROR: nvidia-smi failed, no amdgpu device found, or no fresh intel_gpu_top sample.

targets.expr: max by (host, vendor) (label_replace(gpu_exporter_collection_error{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Scrape target up
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape the exporter. DOWN means the exporter is not answering.

targets.expr: max by (host, job) (label_replace(up{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Age of last successful collection
panels.description: Seconds since each exporter last collected successfully. It climbs steadily when an exporter is stuck.

targets.expr: time() - max by (host, vendor) (label_replace(gpu_exporter_last_collection_timestamp_seconds{job=~"${job:regex}", vendor=~"${vendor:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Performance state
panels.description: nvidia-smi P-state: P0 = maximum performance, P8 = idle, P12+ = minimum.

targets.expr: max by (host, gpu) (label_replace(nvidia_gpu_performance_state{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: GTT (system memory mapped for the GPU)
panels.description: System RAM the GPU has mapped (solid) and can map (dashed). Grows when VRAM overflows.

targets.expr: max by (host, gpu) (label_replace(amd_gpu_gtt_used_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, gpu) (label_replace(amd_gpu_gtt_total_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Runtime power state
panels.description: SUSPENDED: the GPU is in runtime power-management sleep and its sensors are not read, so other AMD panels show gaps.

targets.expr: max by (host, gpu) (label_replace(amd_gpu_runtime_suspended{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Engine busy
panels.description: Busy time per engine class from intel_gpu_top. Video = media decode/encode, Render/3D = shaders, Compute = OpenCL/oneAPI. Select one host to see a single GPU.

targets.expr: max by (host, engine) (label_replace(intel_gpu_engine_busy_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Engine semaphore / event wait
panels.description: Time engines spent waiting on a semaphore (solid) or an event (dashed).

targets.expr: max by (host, engine) (label_replace(intel_gpu_engine_semaphore_wait_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host, engine) (label_replace(intel_gpu_engine_wait_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: RC6 residency (sleep)
panels.description: Share of time in the RC6 power-saving state. Intel gpu_utilization_ratio is roughly 1 − this.

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(intel_gpu_rc6_ratio{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Frequency: actual vs requested
panels.description: Actual frequency (solid) against the frequency the driver requested (dashed). Actual below requested means throttling.

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(gpu_clock_graphics_hz{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}", vendor="intel"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host) (label_replace(intel_gpu_frequency_requested_hz{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Interrupts
panels.description: GPU interrupts per second.

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(intel_gpu_interrupts_per_second{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: intel_gpu_top power
panels.description: Power as reported by intel_gpu_top (mainly integrated GPUs; discrete Arc cards report power through hwmon instead).

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(intel_gpu_power_gpu_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host) (label_replace(intel_gpu_power_package_watts{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Memory controller bandwidth
panels.description: IMC read (solid) and write (dashed) bandwidth from intel_gpu_top, where the platform reports it.

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(intel_gpu_imc_read_bytes_per_second{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host) (label_replace(intel_gpu_imc_write_bytes_per_second{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))

panels.title: hwmon / xpu-smi status
panels.description: Whether the exporter could read hwmon (power, energy, temperature) and xpu-smi (memory).

targets.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(intel_exporter_hwmon_error{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
max by (host) (label_replace(intel_exporter_xpu_error{job=~"${job:regex}", ${hostlabel}=~"${host:regex}"}, "host", "$1", "${hostlabel}", "(.*)"))
